texts.zh:
随着[planet.GetName]殖民地的不断扩张，越来越多证据显示有一个使用活体金属的已灭绝文明曾在此活动，尽管至今未发现他们获取这种材料的任何线索。

最近出现了一个答案：一个被力场包裹、闪烁着奇异光芒的球体，从深层核心的熔岩流中缓缓升起。 其最初用途与构造尚不明朗，但在极高温度下，它会持续滴落出活体金属。这一发现虽巧妙地解开了那桩考古谜团，却也让我们面临新的抉择——该如何处置它。
texts.en:
As the colony on [planet.GetName] grew, so too did evidence of an extinct civilization that made use of Living Metal, though there was no trace of where they acquired this material.

An answer has recently surfaced, in the form of a strange shimmering sphere encased in a force field which buoyed up from deep core magma flows. Its original purpose and construction are not immediately obvious, but it produces a steady drip of Living Metal when exposed to extremely high temperatures. While this handily solves that archaeological puzzle, we must now decide what to do with it.

tooltips.zh: 这件奇物是我们从未研发过的，它不仅是活体金属的一种宝贵来源，还具有科研与历史价值。
tooltips.en: This curious object is unlike anything we have developed. It is not only useful as a source of Living Metal, but also serves as a scientific and historical curiosity worth studying.

label.en: Toss it back into the lava.

tooltips.zh: 一个因无法自我调整而覆灭的种族无可歌颂。这些遗物就该被销毁，彻底消失在历史里。
tooltips.en: There is nothing to be admired about a civilization that failed to adapt and went extinct. The artifact is to be disposed of and forgotten.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 熔融核心 / Molten Core

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/infernals_1_events.txt:6007-6060`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3725-3740 (on_colony_1_year_old: weight 20 each of a 510 list, with the Strange Worlds events)`
- DLC：Infernals Species Pack
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

同一随机池（on_colony_1_year_old，权重20/510）；火山星球、有地狱族、所属国此前未触发过（triggered_molten_core）。

The same random pool (on_colony_1_year_old, weight 20 of 510); a volcanic planet with Infernals, the owner not yet triggered (triggered_molten_core).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口：保留遗物（获得标本 infernal_molten_core）或扔回熔岩（获得每月凝聚力加成，tier2）。

A single window: keep the artifact (gain the specimen infernal_molten_core) or toss it into the lava (a monthly unity bonus, tier 2).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

二选一。

One of two.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了触发池与两个选项。

Trigger pool and both options were checked.
